meta_description: Software developer building web apps, tools, and open-source projects. Explore my work, experience, and get in touch.

about_body: I'm a software developer focused on building performant, accessible, and maintainable products. I enjoy taking ideas from concept to production, whether that means shipping a full application solo or collaborating closely within a team.
contact_body: Reach out on any of these platforms — I'm always happy to chat about projects, collaboration, or ideas.

project_1_short: A dashboard for visualizing live event streams with sub-second updates.
project_1_long: A full-stack analytics platform that ingests millions of events per day and renders them in real time. Built the streaming pipeline, the query layer, and a responsive charting UI. Focused heavily on performance, keeping the interface smooth even under heavy load.
project_2_short: A developer CLI that automates repetitive project setup and deployment tasks.
project_2_long: An open-source command-line toolkit adopted by hundreds of developers. It scaffolds projects, manages environments, and handles deployments with a single command. I maintained the plugin architecture and documentation, and reviewed community contributions.
project_3_short: A cross-platform fitness tracker built with a small product team.
project_3_long: Worked with a team of four to design and ship a fitness tracking app. I owned the offline-first sync engine and the workout-planning feature. We shipped to both app stores and grew to thousands of active users in the first months.
tech_stack_body: This site is built with Svelte 5, SvelteKit, Tailwind CSS, Paraglide for localization, TypeScript, Vite, and other tools. Automated builds and deployments are set up via GitHub Actions: every push to the main branch triggers a fresh build and deploys the latest version.
experience.desc1: Built scalable web applications with a team of 10. Migrated legacy systems to modern cloud architecture.
experience.desc2: Developed MVP for a fintech product from scratch. Responsible for both backend (Node.js) and frontend (React).
